newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Wing Lee says to offer 70 mln new shrs in IPO.
newsitem.headline: HK's Wing Lee says to offer 70 mln new shrs in IPO.

text.p: Electronic components maker Wing Lee Holdings Ltd said on Monday it is issuing 70 million new shares at HK$1.00 each in its initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.
The issue price represents a prospective price/earnings multiple of 7.11 times on a proforma fully-diluted basis and 6.41 times P/E on a weighted average basis, the company said.
The company, a manufacturer of DC switches, jacks, AC sockets and speaker terminals, will have a market capitalisation of HK$280 million.
The IPO will run from March 25 to April 1 and dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin on April 10.
Lippo Securities is the sponsor and manager of the issue.

The company said the net proceeds of about HK$59.5 million would be used to expand and upgrade its production facilities and machineries in Hong Kong and China, and for repayment of bank loans and for working capital.
Wing Lee forecasts its combined profit after tax but before extraordinaries of not less than HK$38 million for the year ending in September 30, 1997, up from over HK$26 million in the previous year.
